head: Lenovo Googlebook Duet 13 leak: detachable Googlebook may launch in January
dek: New pictures shared by leaker Evan Blass show the Lenovo Googlebook Duet 13, a 13-inch tablet with a detachable keyboard, and he says it launches in January. Neither Lenovo nor Google has announced it.
details: The leak shows a magnetic pen that docks and charges on the keyboard and a back cover that folds out as a stand. Chrome Unboxed says earlier filings point to a 13-inch OLED screen, a MediaTek Dimensity chip and 16 GB of memory, and that the device was known before as the Duet m. Google said last month that detachable Googlebooks are coming soon. There's no price yet.
where: Rumored for January, possibly at CES 2027
means: If you want a Googlebook you can use as a tablet, a first detachable model may be weeks away.
todo: Nothing to do yet; wait for Lenovo's announcement and the price.
